defects.title: API used 0.40 instead of configured 0.65 detector threshold
defects.evidence: Processing endpoint hardcoded 0.40; exact baseline returned 44 candidates

defects.title: Sub-resolution detections entered proposal pipeline
defects.evidence: 21 of 44 baseline detections were below 24 px min dimension
defects.fix: Filter candidates below quality_assessor.min_face_size and rerun NMS in CVEngine

defects.title: No EXIF orientation correction
defects.evidence: CV2 ingestion did not normalize orientation
defects.fix: Added Pillow EXIF transpose for path and byte ingestion, with alpha-preserving PNG fallback

defects.title: Post-fix PNG alpha became black
defects.evidence: Initial Pillow conversion lost transparent alpha
defects.fix: Preserve RGBA and composite through existing white-background helper

defects.title: 44 to 23 candidate reduction does not establish 23 real faces
defects.evidence: No manually verified ground-truth face annotations
defects.fix: Human annotation and benchmark against labeled ground truth

defects.title: Recognition proposals are unverified
defects.evidence: Only roster similarity data exists; no independently verified identities
defects.fix: Controlled labeled matching dataset and calibrated threshold validation

defects.title: CSV/XLS export only available after confirmation
defects.fix: Document intended behavior or offer explicit unconfirmed preview if product requires it
